EN: You're heading in there? You are crazy, man!
ZH: 你们要冲进去？你们疯了吧，伙计！

EN: Aaaaaaaaaah!
ZH: 啊啊啊！

EN: Whatever, man! I'm gone!
ZH: 随便啦，伙计！我走了！

EN: Outside's clear. Move out while you can.
ZH: 外面已经清理干净了。趁机撤！

EN: We're not safe either!
ZH: 我们也不安全！

EN: Rejoice! The heroes are here!
ZH: 欢欣鼓舞！英雄驾到！

EN: Those robots are very rude. You here to escort me outside, sweetie?
ZH: 那些机器人真没礼貌。你是来护送我出去的吗，亲爱的？

EN: Thank you, dear. Now do I have everything? My purse. My cat. Oven is turned off. Time to go.
ZH: 谢谢你，亲爱的。都带齐了吗？手提包。我的猫。炉子也关好了。好了，走了。

EN: Oh! But of course, honey! Here you go, 1 cap.
ZH: 哦！当然可以，亲爱的！给你，1个瓶盖。

EN: We can't accompany you, but the path's open.
ZH: 我们不能陪同，但路已经打通了。

EN: We shut them down for you. Tip's appreciated.
ZH: 我们帮你把它们关掉了。小费我们就不客气地收下啦。

EN: Citizen, this is an active combat zone. Surrender your life.
ZH: 市民，此处是交战区。请交出你的生命。

EN: This must be the leader. Let's send it to the scrapyard.
ZH: 这肯定是领头的。把它送进废铁场。

EN: Securitrons Uncapped
ZH: 脱缰的保安机器人

EN: You're a real hero! I don't have any Caps, but maybe you can make use of this.
ZH: 你是个真正的英雄！我没有任何瓶盖，但也许你能用得上这个。

EN: I don't believe it! No one makes a hot dog out of Bigsby. I can't pay you, but maybe you can make some use of this.
ZH: 我不相信！怎么可能有人用比格斯比做热狗。我没法付钱给你，但你也许能用得上这个。

EN: Thank goodness! I thought my buns were toast.
ZH: 谢天谢地！我还以为我必死无疑了。

EN: Some of those Raiders left for a warehouse and took my dog, Bigsby, with them.
ZH: 那些掠夺者离开后去了仓库，并带走了我的狗，比格斯比。

EN: I think they're going to eat him!
ZH: 我觉得他们会吃了它的！

EN: You've got to save him and give him a good home!
ZH: 你们一定要救救它，给它一个温暖的家！

EN: Dognapping is a crime. I'll get him back!
ZH: 绑架狗可是犯罪啊，我们会把它找回来的！

EN: If anything's toast, it's your dog.
ZH: 如果有什么被烤了的话，那也是你的狗。

EN: You've picked up a distress call from an abandoned building. Assemble a rescue team and find the source!
ZH: 你收到了来自一幢废弃建筑的求救信号。召集救援小队去找到信号源吧！

EN: SOS!
ZH: 救命啊！

EN: Find the source.
ZH: 找到信号源。

EN: Find the source of the distress call.
ZH: 找到求救信号的信号源。

EN: I... I just *literally* said you're too late. What's the matter with you?
ZH: 我……我只是说你太迟了。你怎么了？

EN: Well, in your case it'll be a lot quicker!
ZH: 好吧，如果是你的话，它会更快！

EN: Oh, sure, if you're going to cheat and use *weapons*...
ZH: 哦，当然，如果你要欺骗和使用武器的话……

EN: Well, well, well... Look what the Radroaches dragged in.
ZH: 好吧，好吧……看看辐射蟑螂拖来了什么。

EN: You're too late - we've spiked your water with radioactive waste!
ZH: 你太晚了，我们把放射性废物加入了你的水！

EN: We used very low doses to avoid detection.
ZH: 我们使用非常低的剂量，以避免检测。

EN: You'll all be dead in a matter of decades! Mwahaha!
ZH: 你会在几十年内都会死的！哈哈哈！

EN: You won't get away with this!
ZH: 你休想逃脱！

EN: That's... actually an improvement, given our life expectancy.
ZH: 那是……其实是改善，给我们增加了寿命。

EN: You'll be dead in a matter of seconds.
ZH: 你会在几秒钟内死去。

EN: Well, let's not get hasty... We do have Mondays off.
ZH: 好吧，我们不要草率行事……我们星期一休息。

EN: I know, right? It's as if... Wait, what?
ZH: 我知道，对吧？这就像……等等，什么？

EN: Well, he did give us these. They're only a month past their expiry date.
ZH: 他确实给了我们这些东西，只是过期了一个月。

EN: Hey, how come *you* get to wear a Radiation Suit?
ZH: 嘿，你怎么会穿上防辐射服？

EN: It's bad enough the boss has us poisoning people with radioactive materials.
ZH: 老大让我们用放射性物质毒害人已经够糟糕的了。

EN: Least he could do is give us adequate protection.
ZH: 至少他还能给我们足够的保护。

EN: Maybe we should just leave this Raider clan.
ZH: 也许我们该离开这个掠夺者部落了。

EN: He's not even protecting you from undercover saboteurs.
ZH: 他甚至不能保护你免遭秘密破坏者的伤害。

EN: The boss doesn't care about your health.
ZH: 老板不关心你的健康。

EN: We found some worrying info in the documents retrieved from the Raider base. It appears they made camp in a nearby uranium mine to poison our water supply. We need to send someone to stop this... discreetly, of course.
ZH: 我们在掠夺者基地的文件中发现了一些令人担忧的信息。他们似乎在附近的一个铀矿井里毒害我们的水源。我们需要派人……当然是谨慎地阻止他们。

EN: Sabotage!
ZH: 破坏！

EN: Stop Raiders from poisoning the water.
ZH: 阻止下毒的掠夺者。

EN: Counter a plot to poison the Vault's water supply.
ZH: 对抗毒害避难所供水的阴谋。

EN: All right! “We wish you a Merry Christmas... We wish you a Merry Christmas...”
ZH: 好吧！“叮叮当……叮叮当……铃儿响叮当……”

EN: Boo! Get out of here!
ZH: 嘘！滚出去！

EN: Wait. You're not Santa!
ZH: 等等，你不是圣诞老人！

EN: This is the worst Christmas ever!
ZH: 这真是最糟糕的圣诞节！

EN: We're Santa's Helpers! Now come on, sing some carols with us!
ZH: 我们是圣诞的帮手！现在快点，跟我们一起唱点圣诞颂歌！

EN: You know what? We're telling Santa you belong on the naughty list.
ZH: 你知道吗？我们会告诉圣诞老人你要上“坏孩子”名单。

EN: We believe in Santa! Here. Give him this if you see him!
ZH: 我们相信圣诞老人！来拿着，如果你们看到他就把这个给他！

EN: Santa's Helpers are mean! Get out of our Vault!
ZH: 圣诞老人的帮手也太坏了吧！快滚出我们的避难所！

EN: Hello, Santa's Helpers! We've been a very good Vault this year!
ZH: 你们好！圣诞的帮手们！我们避难所今年表现得很好哦！

EN: Tell Santa we'd really like some new Vault Suits!
ZH: 告诉圣诞老人我们真的需要一些新的避难所套装！

EN: Oooh, and some Water Chips!
ZH: 哦，还要一些水质芯片！

EN: Santa's coming, but you gotta believe in him, or he won't show!
ZH: 圣诞老人来了，但是你们要相信他，不然他不会出现的！

EN: Nope. Naughty list for you.
ZH: 才不要。恐怕你要上“坏孩子”名单。

EN: Very well. Here.
ZH: 很好，来，给你们。

EN: Here you are!
ZH: 拿去吧！

EN: Money makes the world go round, right?
ZH: 有钱能使鬼推磨，不是么？

EN: Such generosity! Good luck out there, Santa's Helpers!
ZH: 这么慷慨！希望你们一路顺利，圣诞的帮手们！

EN: I'm Overseer Nicholas. A warm Vault welcome to you!
ZH: 我是监督者尼古拉斯！温暖的避难所欢迎你们！

EN: Santa himself would be proud of the good cheer you're spreading!
ZH: 圣诞老人一定为你们传播圣诞气氛而感到自豪！

EN: You deserve something special for yourselves. How can we repay you?
ZH: 你们值得得到点好东西。我们该怎么回报你们呢？

EN: We want the best weapon your Vault's got.
ZH: 我们想要避难所里最好的武器。

EN: All this holiday cheer means we could use some new outfits.
ZH: 所有的节日气氛都意味着我们可以有一些新衣服。

EN: Caps. Cold, hard bottlecaps.
ZH: 瓶盖。冰冷而又坚硬的瓶盖。

EN: Giving is its own reward. We don't need anything!
ZH: 给予本身就是最好的奖励了，我们什么都不需要！

EN: Santa's gone missing, and we can only bring him back by spreading some Christmas cheer!
ZH: 圣诞老人消失了，我们只能通过四处传播节日气氛来找回他！

EN: Santa's Helpers
ZH: 圣诞老人的小帮手

EN: Speak to Overseer Nicholas.
ZH: 和监督者尼古拉斯交谈。

EN: Talk to the Dwellers.
ZH: 和居民们交谈。

EN: Talk to the Dwellers.
ZH: 和居民们交谈。

EN: Spread Christmas cheer!
ZH: 传播圣诞的节日气氛！

EN: You're wrong! And don't count on us to reveal how Daylight Savings will let us live!
ZH: 错了。不要指望我们告诉你“节省天光”将如何让我们生活！

EN: If the Confessor were here instead of upstairs with the detonator, he'd tell you you're wrong!
ZH: 如果忏悔者在这里而不是在楼上和炸药在一起，他会告诉你，你错了！

EN: It's the Vault Dwellers!
ZH: 这是避难所居民！

EN: They must have learned of our plans in spite of our legendary secrecy.
ZH: 他们一定知道我们的计划，尽管这是我们的顶级秘密。

EN: Kill them before they find Confessor Alvarado, who's just a bit farther away!
ZH: 在他们找到忏悔者阿尔瓦拉多之前杀死他们，他只是有点远！

EN: Don't let them get their hands on the Bomb!
ZH: 别让他们碰上炸弹！

EN: Don't you guys realize the blast will kill you too?
ZH: 你们不知道爆炸会杀了你们吗？

EN: Yeah, about that secrecy thing... you guys aren't very good at it!
ZH: 是的，关于那秘密的事……你们不是很擅长！

EN: May Atom have mercy on your soul!
ZH: 愿原子能宽恕你的灵魂！

EN: No need to, we'll all be spared - but you won't!
ZH: 没有必要，我们都会得到宽恕-但你不会！

EN: That's... a very good question. Let me get back to you on that.
ZH: 那是……一个很好的问题。让我回头再答复你。

EN: Rejoice! E-Ster is upon us!
ZH: 好开心！复活节降临在我们身上！

EN: The dying sun will be replaced by a brand new one!
ZH: 即将死去的太阳将被一个崭新的太阳取代！

EN: You will be washed away with all other sinners.
ZH: 你将和其他罪人一起被冲走。

EN: A good wash wouldn't do you any harm yourself...
ZH: 好好洗脸会死吗……

EN: You would sacrifice yourself for Atom?
ZH: 你会为了原子而牺牲自己吗？

EN: If we're now on the Fifth Sun, what happend to the other ones?
ZH: 如果我们现在在第五个太阳上，其他的太阳都发生了什么？

EN: Silence! Your words have no power over me!
ZH: 沉默！你的话语对我没有力量！

EN: ♪ La la la la ♪  I can't hear you!
ZH: ♪ 啦啦啦啦 ♪ 我听不到你！

EN: Nice try! Now let me concentrate as I input the detonation code...
ZH: 厉害了！现在让我集中精力输入引爆代码……

EN: Ah, Dwellers! We meet again. How do you like my new look?
ZH: 啊，居民们！我们又见面了。你们觉得我的新发型怎么样？

EN: The old Alvarado is part of the past now. This is a new me, for a new age.
ZH: 曾经的阿尔瓦拉多已经属于过去了。这是一个新的我，一个新的时代。

EN: Blessed Daylight Saving Time will safely carry us one hour into the future, after the blast.
ZH: 神圣的夏令时将在爆炸之后，把我们安全地送去一小时之后的未来。

EN: You will perish in flames while we are transported into a new era!
ZH: 当我们被带入一个新时代的时候，你们将在火焰中死去！

EN: I don't think that's how Daylight Saving is supposed to work...
ZH: 我不认为夏令时是这样运作的……

EN: You fool, you won't be transported into the future, you'll die as well!
ZH: 你这个傻瓜，你不会被传送到未来，你也会死的！

EN: Why not wait until tomorrow, see if the sun is still there?
ZH: 为什么不等到明天，看看太阳是否还在那里？

EN: We need to stop Confessor Alvarado and the Church of the Children of Atom before they detonate their 20-megaton nuclear device, lest the entire area be vaporized!
ZH: 我们需要赶在忏悔者阿尔瓦拉多和原子之子的教会引爆那枚2000万吨级的核装置之前阻止他们，否则整个地区都会被蒸发！

EN: Saving Daylight
ZH: 节省天光

EN: Stop Confessor Alvarado's Plans.
ZH: 停止忏悔者阿尔瓦拉多的计划。

EN: Stop the Children of Atom from blowing up the area!
ZH: 阻止原子之子炸毁整个地区！

EN: We will, we promise! Here, take this... it's everything we have.
ZH: 我们会的，我保证！来，拿着……这是我们全部的东西。

EN: Wait, what? It's not a ghost... get 'em!
ZH: 等等，什么？根本就不是鬼……给我拿下他们！

EN: Huh? Hey! It's just a costume... get 'em!
ZH: 哈？嘿！只是一套服装……给我拿下他们！

EN: Hallow-what? Hey! This ghost is a fake... get 'em!
ZH: 万圣什么？嘿！这是一个假的鬼……给我拿下他们！

EN: What?! This place is really haunted?
ZH: 什么玩意？！这个地方难道真的闹鬼？

EN: We cooked up that story so we could rob this Vault blind.
ZH: 我们编造了这个故事，这样就可以随便抢劫了。

EN: We're sorry. Just don't hurt us!
ZH: 我们很抱歉。请不要伤害我们！

EN: Boooo! Leave this place and never come baaaaaack!
ZH: 呜呜呜呜呜！离开这里，永远都别回来哎哎哎哎！

EN: Trick or treat!
ZH: 不给糖就捣蛋！

EN: I can't believe this actually worked.
ZH: 真不敢相信他们居然信了。

EN: Happy Halloween!
ZH: 万圣节快乐！

EN: With the Ghost Costumes in hand, it's time to head out to Vault 31 and confront the Raiders there once and for all!
ZH: 有了这些鬼服，就可以去31号避难所和掠夺者们决一死战了！

EN: Scare Tactics
ZH: 恐吓战术

EN: Confront the Raiders at Vault 31.
ZH: 在31号避难所和掠夺者对峙。

EN: Confront the Raiders at Vault 31.
ZH: 在31号避难所和掠夺者对峙。

EN: No. I won't. Now why don't you move along and let me science?
ZH: 不，我不会的。现在你们为什么不继续前进，让我一个人搞科学呢？

EN: In fact, we do! It's so nice to meet another scientist! Take a look at this piece I've been working on!
ZH: 其实我们也是！能见到另一个科学家真是太棒了！快看看这个我最近研究的东西！

EN: That's the Wasteland for you! Feel free to look around.
ZH: 废土就是这样！请随便参观。

EN: Are you the researchers from the Vault? Excellent!
ZH: 你是来自避难所的研究员吗？太赞了！

EN: We're the Wasteland Laser Association. Membership limited.
ZH: 我们这里是废土激光协会。成员数有限。

EN: A laser in every hand is our motto!
ZH: 人手一把激光枪是我们的座右铭。

EN: Make us some Laser Rifles, nerd.
ZH: 呆子，给我们弄点激光步枪呗。

EN: Astounding! Do you use a helium-neon mixture for the laser gain medium?
ZH: 惊人！你们会用氦氖混合物作为激光的增益介质吗？

EN: This is a terrible place to do laser research.
ZH: 这个地方真不适合搞激光枪研究。

EN: Vandalism for science! Never mind. You just don't get it. Excuse me.
ZH: 为了科学而蓄意破坏的！算了，说了你们也不明白。恕我失陪。

EN: I know! Check out this little project I've been working on. Here!
ZH: 对呀！快来看看我最近在做的小项目。看这里！

EN: It's not ideal, but that's the price of progress! Sorry. I should get back to it.
ZH: 还不算完美，但这就是进步的代价！抱歉。我应该回去工作了。

EN: Hi there! Welcome to our Physics Club!
ZH: 你们好！欢迎来到物理俱乐部！

EN: We hit things, and see what happens! It's science!
ZH: 我们会对东西射击，然后看看会发生什么！这就是科学！

EN: That just sounds like vandalism.
ZH: 听起来像是破坏公物。

EN: A Physics Club? How positively Newtonian!
ZH: 一个物理俱乐部？果然是积极向上的牛顿精神！

EN: This place isn't exactly safe for doing science experiments.
ZH: 这个地方对于做科学实验来说并不安全。

EN: Such a barbaric attitude! We clearly have nothing more to discuss.
ZH: 多么粗暴的态度！我们显然没什么多余的好谈了。

EN: It is! I've been making a few new compounds. Check them out!
ZH: 是的！我最近研制出几款新的化合物。一起来看看吧！

EN: Nonsense! Science is not a coward's game! Now, if you'll excuse me...
ZH: 胡说！科学可不是什么懦夫的游戏！现在，恕我失陪……

EN: Hurray, it's the Dwellers!
ZH: 哦耶，是居民们！

EN: We're the Coalition of Cool Chemists. We think we're pretty neat.
ZH: 我们是由一帮很酷的化学家组成的联盟。我们很牛！

EN: Chemistry is useless for anything but explosives.
ZH: 除了爆炸，化学一点用都没有。

EN: A coalition of chemists? That's dynamite!
ZH: 化学家联盟？你们太了不起了！

EN: You should leave. It's not safe.
ZH: 你们应该走了，这里不安全。

EN: How dare you! These people are dead, but not forgotten! Now leave me alone!
ZH: 你怎么敢这么说？！这些人是死了，但没有被遗忘！离我们远点！

EN: Finally people who understand! Here, for a fellow sawbones!
ZH: 终于有人懂了！来，拿着，给外科医生用的！

EN: Science waits for nothing, I'm afraid. I must continue. If you'll excuse me.
ZH: 科学不等人，我恐怕得继续了。恕我失陪……

EN: Ah, yes! Help has arrived from the local Vault.
ZH: 啊，太好了，当地避难所的人来帮我们了！

EN: We're the Wasteland Coroner's Association. We help catalogue all the dead people out here.
ZH: 我们是废土验尸官协会的。我们会将所有死亡的人进行登记。

EN: So far it's just a process of saying: “Yep. He's dead.”
ZH: 目前的流程好像就只有说一声：“没错，他死了。”

EN: So what you're saying is, you're useless.
ZH: 所以你们的意思是，你们毫无用处。

EN: You're studying the dead? That's captivatingly cadaverous!
ZH: 你们研究死人？特别迷恋尸体那种苍白的颜色？

EN: The Wasteland is dangerous. There's no time to study dead people.
ZH: 废土是很危险的，可没时间研究死人。

EN: Now what kind of an attitude is that? Why don't you get away from my plants?
ZH: 那是什么态度？你为什么不离我的植物远点？

EN: Hurray! Glad you appreciate my work. Here. Take a little something.
ZH: 真开心有人感激我做的一切。来拿着，给你们的。

EN: It's not just gardening, it's science! Never mind. Just leave me to my work.
ZH: 这不是只是园艺，是科学！算了。让我好好工作吧。

EN: It's the Vault Dwellers! Thank you so much for coming.
ZH: 是避难所的居民们！非常高兴你们能前来。

EN: This is the Bubbly Botanist Bureau. We combine flowers with smiles!
ZH: 这里是泡泡多园艺总局。我们把鲜花和微笑结合起来！

EN: Flowers and smiles are useless. Only cruelty rules the Wasteland!
ZH: 鲜花和微笑无用。残酷才能统治废土！

EN: We hope you're growing some delightful daffodils and righteous roses!
ZH: 我们希望你们能种出那些讨人喜欢的水仙花和真正的玫瑰！

EN: No offense, but this is a dangerous place to be gardening.
ZH: 恕我冒犯，但在这地方搞园艺有点危险啊。

EN: Oh no, that won't do at all! Thanks for your opinion, though. Forgive me, I need to ponder.
ZH: 哦不行的，完全行不通！不过还是谢谢你的建议。抱歉我需要时间考虑。

EN: Of course! It all makes sense now! Here, for your vital assistance!
ZH: 当然！现在说得通了！来拿着，可以在关键时候帮助你！

EN: An organic beam emitter? I think that technology might be far too advanced. Oh well...
ZH: 一个有机光电发射器？我还以为这个技术过于先进了。既然这样……

EN: Ah, good, the Dwellers! I need your Vault-Tec expertise!
ZH: 啊，好的，居民们！我需要你们拿出避难所科技的专业水准！

EN: Tell me, what kind of beam emitter is best for use in a laser-based surgery apparatus?
ZH: 告诉我，哪种光电发射器最适合在激光手术装置中使用？

EN: We prefer ones that set people on fire.
ZH: 我们更喜欢那种能让敌人着火的东西。

EN: Use a proton emitter. It's positively positronic!
ZH: 质子发射器。感觉应该是这个！
